source.author: lucan
source.text_english: Never by a happy omen are we wretched men torn apart.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ille pavens, laeto quamquam omine divum, prosiluit stratis.
reuse.text_original: ille pavens, laeto quamquam omine divum, / prosiluit stratis.
reuse.text_english: Trembling, he sprang up from his couch, though the gods had given a favorable omen.
